[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (lst: List Int) (result: Option Int) (min1: Int) (min2: Int) : Option Int :=
  match lst with
  | [] => result
  | head :: tail =>
    if result = none then
      if min2 = min1 then
        loop tail (some min1) min1 head
      else
        loop tail (some min1) head min2
    else
      match result with
      | none => loop tail (some min1) min1 head
      | some curr_min =>
        if curr_min < min1 then
          loop tail (some curr_min) curr_min min1
        else if curr_min < min2 then
          loop tail (some curr_min) min1 curr_min
        else
          loop tail result min1 min2
loop lst none Int.max_value Int.max_value
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation lst
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
by_cases h_result_none: result = none
-- case where result = none
simp [h_result_none]
have h_no_second_smallest := List.no_two_distinct_smallest lst
simp [h_no_second_smallest]
intro h_two_distinct_smallest
have h_two_distinct_smallest': ∃ i j, i < lst.length ∧ j < lst.length ∧ i ≠ j ∧ lst.get! i < lst.get! j := by
  assumption
linarith
-- case where result = some x
simp [h_result_none]
have h_result_some: result = some (implementation loop lst Int.max_value Int.max_value) := by
  simp [result]
  assumption
have h_loop_termination := loop(lst, Int.max_value, Int.max_value, Int.max_value).termination
simp [h_loop_termination]
let min1 := (implementation loop lst Int.max_value Int.max_value).get!
let min2 := (implementation loop lst Int.max_value Int.max_value).get!
have h_min1_min2 := min1 < min2
have h_smaller_els := (loop lst Int.max_value Int.max_value min1).filter (· < min2)
have h_len_smaller_els := h_smaller_els.length > 0
have h_smaller_els_all_same := h_smaller_els.all (λ x => x = min1)
simp [h_len_smaller_els, h_smaller_els_all_same]
[END]
